**Functional summary:** The 390-amino-acid sequence is an exact, full-length match to the reviewed *Exiguobacterium artemiae* protein UniProt B1YMC6, annotated as **8-amino-7-oxononanoate synthase (BioF; EC 2.3.1.47)**. It is a pyridoxal-5′-phosphate (PLP)-dependent enzyme in biotin biosynthesis. It catalyzes the condensation and decarboxylation of pimeloyl-ACP with L-alanine to form 8-amino-7-oxononanoate (AON), holo-ACP, and CO₂. The reviewed reference is annotated as a homodimer.

**Sequence-derived properties:** Estimated molecular mass is **42.6 kDa**, theoretical pI **5.54**, and GRAVY **−0.096**. Pfam scanning detects an aminotransferase-family domain spanning residues 39–380.

The exact sequence match strongly supports the functional assignment. Mass, pI, and GRAVY are sequence-based estimates; oligomeric state and cofactor/function annotations are inherited from the reviewed reference, not experimentally measured for the supplied sample.
